rationale: Supplied mechanical validation confirms clean application, allowlisted files and preserved question schema, including Status: Solved. The proposal directly resolves retention, synthesis acceptance, corrections and later Clarify context. Exact sources remain independent of derived prose; bidirectional coverage, explicit review and version-bound admission make replacement auditable. Failure handling and finite-budget behavior prevent silent loss, while privacy rules cover retained derivatives. The documentation clearly distinguishes the adopted product contract from outstanding implementation evidence. No blocking fixes are apparent.
risks: Semantic fidelity depends on thorough operator review; complete structural coverage cannot detect all omissions or distorted qualifications.
Growing source histories increase storage, synthesis and review costs. Concrete limits and derivative-purge behavior still require implementation and validation.

rationale: Patch applies cleanly, touches only the three allowlisted files, and the question metadata line is updated correctly with Status: Solved and Resolved by: UBU-D0317 while preserving all other fields. The decision directly answers the question: it specifies the retention mechanism (durable per-Task source records with provenance and append-only supersession links, answers admitted independently of synthesis), the acceptance criterion (bidirectional source-to-prose coverage map plus explicit version-bound operator approval, with failure preserving prior prose and saved answers), bounding (declared finite budgets, chunking along source records, stop-rather-than-truncate), and later-Clarify context (originals retrieved, narrative not treated as sole memory). It honours the operator's 'lore field, not transcript' direction by keeping the description as prose and the Q&A as separate backing records, and explicitly forbids invented agreement and lossy replacement. The resolution text correctly scopes the outcome as a product contract with implementation evidence outstanding, and requires_human_review is set as the question's auto-choice eligibility demands. Deductions are for verbosity relative to surrounding design entries, an unverifiable cross-reference, and the unaddressed scaling of manual review.
risks: DESIGN.md §1 entry is six dense paragraphs where neighbouring entries (e.g. UBU-D0316) are one; readability of the design doc itself degrades and the mechanism detail (hashes, actor/Device/session/round provenance, chunking) is heavier than a Product-type decision typically carries.

Cross-reference to UBU-D0274's candidate/admission boundary and the backticked type name `AdvisoryCandidate` could not be verified against the ubu-design tree from this scoring context; if D0274 does not define such a boundary or the identifier is new, the decision introduces an unanchored dependency.

Acceptance relies on a full source-by-source operator checklist at every synthesis and after every edit; no incremental-review model is described, so review burden grows with Task history and may push operators toward rubber-stamping, which undermines the losslessness guarantee the decision rests on.

Privacy, partial-replica, purge and storage-exhaustion clauses extend beyond the literal question; they are consistent with adjacent design text but widen the surface a reviewer must accept as part of resolving Q0161.

No follow-up question is filed for the acknowledged gap that structural coverage cannot prove semantic fidelity; the decision honestly states the limit but leaves no tracked item for how manual review scales.
